meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Use Orca orchestration for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply flows, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, or decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` instead for full ownership handoffs, including requests phrased as "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", or "another worktree" when the user did not explicitly ask to supervise, monitor, wait for results, or coordinate a DAG. Use `orca-cli` for ordinary terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, reading or waiting on terminals, and automation of the browser embedded inside Orca. Use Computer Use for browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser.

copy.tagline: 协调多个智能体分工协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把一个大任务拆成多个助手并行处理并汇总结果。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate multiple AI agents to split and execute complex tasks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple AI assistants and need structured task coordination.

howto.what: 需要协调多个智能体时，Claude 会使用 Orca 编排：先选对 orca 命令，再加载与版本匹配的完整指南，然后按指南分发任务、等待结果等。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体分工协作，比如把任务拆成子任务分出去、等它们完成、或排好先后依赖顺序时触发。

say.text: 用 Orca 把这几个子任务分给不同智能体并行处理。
say.note: Claude 会创建并分发这些任务。

say.text: 让智能体 A 先调研，完成后通知 B 接着写报告。
say.note: 这会形成等待前置任务完成的任务流。

say.text: 把整个流程拆成几步，让多个智能体按依赖顺序协作完成。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖顺序编排这些步骤。

howto.what_en: When multi-agent coordination is needed, Claude uses Orca orchestration: picks the session's correct orca executable, loads the version-matched guide via `skills get orchestration`, then runs task-dispatch/wait commands from it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs structured multi-agent coordination: splitting work into subtasks, waiting on worker results, or sequencing task dependencies.

say_en.text: Split these subtasks across agents with Orca, in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude creates and dispatches tasks via orca.

say_en.text: Have agent A research first, then notify agent B to write the report after.
say_en.note: This creates a task flow with a worker-done wait.

say_en.text: Break the workflow into steps and have agents collaborate in dependency order.
say_en.note: Claude arranges the steps as an ordered task chain via orca.
